name: High-voltage energy
description: Battery pack and DC-DC converters powering compressor, fans, valves and compute

name: Gas supply
description: Onboard compressor, air dryer, ground fill port, check valves

name: Gas storage
description: COPV bank (about 600 L at 400 bar), per-vessel isolation and relief, pressure and temperature sensing

name: Distribution
description: Two normally closed master valves in series, regulators, manifold, line valves

name: Thruster array
description: Rear nozzles (Thrust) or 10 perimeter nozzles (Rocket) with fast electric valves and heaters

name: Suction
description: Multi-mode fans, ground-sealing skirt, plenum pressure sensors

name: Chassis
description: Motors, brakes, steer-by-wire, active suspension, active aero

name: Sensing
description: Three IMUs, altimeters, satellite positioning, wheel speeds, cameras

name: Control compute
description: Mode manager, vehicle dynamics controller, thrust control unit, independent safety monitor

name: HMI and arming
description: Yoke, mode selector, physical arm switch, displays and alarms

name: Protection
description: Restraints, rollover structure, external airbags, thrust-neutral emergency venting

name: Arm enable A
description: Safety monitor to master valve A switch; hardwired, energise-to-open

name: Arm enable B
description: Thrust control unit to master valve B switch; hardwired, energise-to-open

name: Thrust command
description: Thrust control unit to valve drivers; 1 kHz, 2 ms, authenticated

name: Driver enable
description: Safety monitor to valve-driver supply; hardwired

name: Zone authorisation
description: Positioning and beacon to mode manager; 10 Hz, two sources

name: Attitude and rates
description: IMUs to both computers; 1 kHz, voting

name: Gas pressure and temperature
description: Sensors to both computers; 500 Hz, dual dissimilar

name: Suction plenum pressure
description: Sensors to vehicle dynamics controller; 200 Hz

name: Mode request
description: HMI to mode manager; physical switch plus two-step confirm

name: Crash signal
description: Airbag controller to both computers; hardwired plus bus

name: Line isolation command
description: Thrust control unit to line valves; 20 ms, read-back
